description: This file defines functions and constants related to heartbeat management, including parsing heartbeat tasks from a markdown file, checking if content is empty, and stripping heartbeat tokens. It also exports types and constants used for heartbeat prompts and task scheduling.

methods.name: isHeartbeatContentEffectivelyEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the HEARTBEAT.md content is effectively empty, meaning it contains only whitespace, comments, or empty lines.

methods.name: resolveHeartbeatPrompt
methods.description: Returns the provided prompt trimmed or the default HEARTBEAT_PROMPT if none is provided.

methods.name: stripTokenAtEdges
methods.description: Removes the HEARTBEAT_TOKEN from the start or end of a string, including trailing punctuation, and trims whitespace.

methods.name: stripHeartbeatToken
methods.description: Removes the HEARTBEAT_TOKEN from a string based on mode and max acknowledgment characters, normalizing markup and HTML tags.

methods.name: parseHeartbeatTasks
methods.description: Parses a markdown content string to extract heartbeat tasks defined in a YAML-like format.

methods.name: isTaskDue
methods.description: Determines if a heartbeat task is due based on its last run time, interval, and current time.
